lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and the property tax levy that funds it — and in the same session takes up second reading of an ordinance that would suspend the 5% Open Space Fund dedication from Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the coming year, a real tension between tight finances and the valley's land-conservation commitments worth paying attention to. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission is also working through updates to its Land Use Code and Master Plan, the foundational documents that shape what gets built where for years to come. Ouray County's BOCC has a full plate too, with resolutions shifting the county's fiscal posture and adopting a first-of-its-kind regional AI governance policy.

notable.stake: Council votes on 2027 budget, tax levy, and open-space fund suspension ordinance.
Norwood P&Z updates Land Use Code and Master Plan, shaping future development rules.
Ouray County BOCC votes to end austerity measures and adopt a new AI governance policy.
Lottery drawings determine who gets workforce housing on Black Bear Road.
